scene.suffix: Tall vertical composition: every important element sits in the central vertical band, the far left and right edges are only plain walls or calm background. Muted desaturated palette of charcoal, slate and dusty teal. No people faces, no text.

photo.suffix: Centered composition with the subject in the middle three quarters of the frame, simple background. No text, no letters.

wall.suffix: Tall vertical composition, subject in the central vertical band, plain space at the top. No text, no letters.

item.suffix: Close-up of one object in the center, simple plain background, soft flat light. No text, no letters, scribbles instead of words.

cctv.suffix: Wide horizontal composition with ground and sky empty around the action. No signs, no text, no letters.

ref.suffix: Plain light grey background, full body, centered. No text.

items.prompt: A long iron sliding gate between two concrete gateposts with plain blank flat panels, tall zelkova trees casting soft shadows, an empty courtyard and a plain grey building beyond, overcast morning, pale grey sky.

School staff room desk seen from the chair: across the desk a teacher's arms in a beige cardigan holding a printed sheet filled with rows of squiggly lines, a mug, folders and a small plant on the desk, rows of other desks blurred behind, cold fluorescent light.

Small school counselling room by a window: a round table with a tissue box and leaflets, a hand holding a plain ceramic mug and a grey sweater sleeve across the table, sheer curtain, soft overcast light.

Inside a Korean apartment entrance in flat daylight: shoe rack with a few worn men's shoes and clean sneakers, the front door with a security chain, a small video intercom panel on the wall beside it, a key tray on a small shelf.

Inside a Korean apartment entrance in dim afternoon: shoe rack with worn shoes, the front door with a security chain, a video intercom panel glowing pale on the wall, tense stillness, darker than daytime.

Inside a Korean apartment entrance at night: shoe rack, the front door with a security chain, orange streetlight leaking through the gap under the door onto the floor, a plain brown envelope lying on the floor just inside, the rest in blue-grey shadow.

Looking through a half-open apartment front door at a young woman standing in the corridor, strongly backlit by a bright corridor window behind her so she is a dark silhouette with no visible face, outline of a cream knit sweater and dark trousers, hands clasped in front holding a small paper bag, plain corridor.

Police station office desk seen from the visitor chair: across the desk a man's forearms in rolled-up white shirt sleeves holding a thin file folder, paper cups, a monitor turned away, a water dispenser in the background, cold fluorescent light, one tube dimmer than the rest.

Convenience store counter seen from the customer side: a small monitor on the counter showing a blurry grayscale street view, an older man's forearm in an apron resting beside it, shelves of plain unlabeled boxes behind, a glowing refrigerated showcase at the side, cold fluorescent light.

Front of a convenience store at midday on an overcast day seen from across a narrow street: glass double door, a blank backlit sign panel, a street bollard and a curb, an empty sidewalk, flat grey sky, utterly ordinary.

Close view of a wall-mounted video door-phone in an apartment hallway: a plain beige plastic housing with a small flat dark grey screen in the center, two round buttons, a speaker grille, a coat hook beside it, dim afternoon light.

Neighbourhood pharmacy counter seen from the customer side: across the counter a woman's hands and white-coat sleeves resting on a paper bag, glass cabinets behind filled with plain unlabeled white and pale green boxes, cold fluorescent light, quiet and guilty mood.

View from inside a pharmacy through a rain-streaked window at dusk: one empty wooden bench on the wet sidewalk in the center, glistening pavement, a street lamp glowing orange, raindrops on the glass, blue-grey sky.

Evening, a pharmacy's metal roll-up shutter pulled halfway down in the center, a thin band of light spilling under it onto the rainy pavement, wet reflections, blue-grey dusk with orange accents, nobody around.

Living room table at night seen from above and in front: a torn plain brown envelope, a small square sticky note with squiggly lines, an old dark smartphone with a charging cable, a half-drunk glass of water, a cool white desk lamp, a dark window behind with orange city lights.

Underground parking garage level at night: concrete pillars with blank panels, wet concrete floor reflecting light, one fluorescent tube flickering overhead, a dark sedan, and a man seen only from behind standing beside it in a long charcoal coat with hands in pockets, orange accent light, deep shadows.

Empty living room at dawn in dim charcoal and slate tones with a faint pale grey glow from the window, a sofa with a folded throw, a phone on the coffee table, at the far end of the hall an open bedroom door onto darkness, very still.

Standing in front of a government building's glass automatic door on a cold clear morning, the sign above the door is an empty blank grey panel. At the bottom of the frame a hand holds two phones side by side, a large plain phone and a smaller dark slim phone, screens off. The door glass reflects street and sky, pale blue-grey light.

Corridor of a government office looking through a large window into a dim room: a young man seen only as a dark silhouette sitting at a table, head bowed, back to us, cold light on this side, plain blank walls and no signs.

Corridor of a government office looking through a large window into a dim room: a young man seen only as a dark silhouette sitting upright at a table with his chin lifted, hands on the table, back to us, cold light on this side, plain blank walls and no signs.

A teenage boy's bedroom in the dark: neatly made bedding, a backpack hung on a chair, a desk in the center where a brand-new smartphone lies glowing with a pale blue screen showing only a blank bubble shape, everything else in deep blue-black shadow.
Kitchen dining table the next morning in flat grey daylight: two chairs, one pulled out slightly, a single untouched bowl and spoon, a phone lying face-down, very tidy and empty, cold.

Warm old family snapshot style cartoon: a Korean family of three standing side by side in a spring park, father in his early fifties, mother in her late forties with shoulder-length hair, and an eleven-year-old boy between them, small full-body figures with simple friendly faces, cherry blossoms, golden afternoon light, warm peach cream and soft yellow palette, slight vignette.

Warm old family snapshot style cartoon, tall: a Korean family of three standing side by side near the bottom third of the frame, father, mother with shoulder-length hair, and an eleven-year-old boy, small figures with simple friendly faces, spring park with cherry blossoms, large soft sky above, golden afternoon light, warm peach cream and soft yellow palette.

Phone snapshot style cartoon: a Korean father in his early fifties with round glasses and short hair going grey at the temples, in a plain dark sweater, and his fifteen-year-old son, a slim boy with short black hair in a plain grey hoodie, standing at an awkward distance apart on a restaurant street, not touching, both looking slightly away from the camera, the boy's face visible and quiet, muted autumn evening colors with a slight warm tint.

Blurry smartphone snapshot of a paper form on a kitchen table taken at an angle: a sheet covered by a grid of empty boxes and wavy lines, a pen lying across it, out of focus, cool grey light, low contrast.
School gate on graduation day: a long blank banner hung over the gate, balloons tied to the fence, nobody around, pale winter sky, muted greys and blues.

Smartphone snapshot of a crumpled narrow paper receipt lying on a doorstep floor, header made of squiggly lines, the bottom of the receipt ripped away, a torn piece of a paper bag with a blank cross-shaped badge beside it, grey floor tiles, flat light.

Phone photo of an official-looking letter lying on a kitchen floor beside a shoe: a white envelope, a folded letter with a heavy red band at the top and rows of squiggly lines, a red stamp shape, dim cool light, shot at an angle from above.

Phone photo of a plain paper letter flat on a desk, a window envelope beside it, a grid of empty cells and wavy lines on the paper, one cell circled in pencil, a calculator at the corner, cool grey-blue light.
Phone photo of a plain paper letter on a desk, slightly tilted, a pen lying on it, a grid of empty cells and wavy lines, one cell circled in pencil, cool grey-blue light.
Phone photo of a plain paper letter folded in half on a desk with a thumb at the edge, a grid of empty cells and wavy lines visible, cool grey-blue light.

Cartoon seen from behind a sofa at high angle: a middle-aged Korean man seen only from behind, resting back on the sofa in a plain jacket, a thin blanket over his lap, a TV in front of him casting a cool blue glow over his shoulders, a dark living room, quiet and calm, mostly blue-grey with a pale TV glow.

A crumpled scrap of a paper pharmacy bag with a blank cross-shaped badge and a narrow white receipt clipped to it, lying on a grey doorstep floor, header made of squiggly lines, the lower part of the receipt cut off with a jagged edge.
A plain brown A4 paper envelope lying on a hallway floor, flap sealed with clear tape, no sender, no address, one smudged fingerprint on a corner, orange light falling across one edge.
A small pale yellow-grey sticky note stuck on a brown envelope, the note is covered with a few neat slanted wavy pen lines, a faint pen smudge.
A small white memo slip with a row of neat slanted pen marks as if a number was written, lying on a shoe cabinet top beside a key tray.
An old smartphone lying on a table with its screen black and off, plain black case without stickers, slightly worn corners, a charging cable lying beside it not plugged in, dim cool light.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk, a curb. The people are tiny distant figures. One tiny slim boy in a hooded jacket stands alone near the shop entrance.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk. Exactly two tiny figures standing shoulder to shoulder in front of the shop entrance: one tall man in a long dark coat and one short slim boy in a hooded jacket, almost touching.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk, a curb. The people are tiny distant figures. A tiny tall man in a long dark coat stands next to a tiny slim boy in a hooded jacket, the man's arm reaching to the boy's shoulder.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk. Exactly two tiny figures standing together in front of the shop: a tall man in a long dark coat whose head is bent down next to the head of a short slim boy in a hooded jacket.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at an empty night street in front of a small dark shop with one glowing window. A pair of two people only, a tall man in a long dark coat on the right and a short boy in a hooded jacket on the left jerking away from him, no one else on the street.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk, a curb. The people are tiny distant figures. A tiny slim boy in a hooded jacket stands with head bowed beside a tiny tall man in a long dark coat, a small car with bright headlights stops at the curb.

Extreme wide shot from a security camera mounted high on a pole far away, looking down at a quiet street corner at night: a small shop with plain dark walls and softly glowing windows, a wet sidewalk, a curb. The people are tiny distant figures. A tiny slim boy in a hooded jacket climbs into the back seat of a small car at the curb while a tiny tall man in a long dark coat holds the car door, red tail lights.

Character reference sheet: two full-body versions side by side of a slim Korean boy, one aged fifteen in a plain grey hoodie and one aged eighteen in a plain navy jacket, short neat black hair, calm quiet expression, narrow shoulders, three-quarter view, simple eyes, no smile.

Character reference sheet: a Korean father in his early fifties with round glasses, short hair going grey at the temples, broad tired shoulders and a plain beige cardigan over a collared shirt, standing beside a Korean mother in her late forties with shoulder-length black hair, a soft gentle smile and a light cardigan, three-quarter view, simple faces.
Dark minimalist game title background: a hallway silhouette in deep blue-black with a single thin vertical line of pale light in the center, a large empty space in the middle.
Flat app icon: a dark blue-grey rounded square with a simple pale phone silhouette and a small red notification dot at its upper right, strong silhouette, readable when small.
